scene: The bronze whale mouth dispenses three colorful travel tokens onto the boardwalk.
picture: A flat side view along the pier's exit plaza. Far left sits an open-roof neon-green shuttle van. Centre-left stands the boy holding his blue ice cream, watching the open-mouthed bronze whale bin. Right waits a red double-decker bus with doors folded open, beside a swinging rope-bridge lift basket attached to a timber tower far right.
